python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,shlex,json,tomllib
from pathlib import Path
hosts=tomllib.loads((Path.home()/'.config/host-ops/config.toml').read_text())['hosts']
h=hosts['termux-phone']
key=Path(h['identity_file']).expanduser()
known=Path.home()/'.cache/photomap-rsync-relay-20261101-v1/adb_usb_known_hosts'
rows=subprocess.run(['adb','devices','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20).stdout.splitlines()[1:]
usb=[row.split()[0] for row in rows if len(row.split())>1 and row.split()[1]=='device' and ':' not in row.split()[0]]
print('USB_COUNT='+str(len(usb)),flush=True)
assert len(usb)==1 and known.is_file()
forward=subprocess.run(['adb','-s',usb[0],'forward','tcp:18123','tcp:8022'],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
assert forward.returncode==0,forward.stderr
try:
 remote=r'''set -u
DEV="$HOME/Projects/PhotoMap/.dev/termux"
printf 'ACTIVE_MARKER='; test -f "$DEV/pi-import-active-20261101-v1.json" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'BACKUP_EXISTS='; test -d "$DEV/rollback-prepi-20261101-v1" && echo yes || echo no
printf 'DEV_DB_BYTES='; stat -c %s "$DEV/data/app.db" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'STAGED_DB_BYTES='; stat -c %s "$DEV/import-pi-20261101-v1/data/app.db" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'DEV_PRIVATE_COUNT='; find "$DEV/storage/private" -type f 2>/dev/null|wc -l
printf 'DEV_PUBLIC_COUNT='; find "$DEV/storage/public" -type f 2>/dev/null|wc -l
printf 'STAGED_PRIVATE_COUNT='; find "$DEV/import-pi-20261101-v1/storage/private" -type f 2>/dev/null|wc -l
printf 'SERVICE='; sv status "$PREFIX/var/service/photomap-dev" || true
for endpoint in /health /api/places/map /; do printf 'PHOTO_%s=' "$endpoint"; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "http://127.0.0.1:8010$endpoint" || true; done
printf 'ILESTOI='; curl -sS -m 8 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/health/ready || true
'''
 a=['ssh','-i',str(key),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','IdentitiesOnly=yes','-o','StrictHostKeyChecking=yes','-o','UserKnownHostsFile='+str(known),'-o','ConnectTimeout=9','-p','18123',str(h['user'])+'@127.0.0.1','bash -c '+shlex.quote(remote)]
 p=subprocess.run(a,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=110)
 print(json.dumps({'status':p.returncode,'out':p.stdout[-5000:],'err':p.stderr[-700:]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
finally:
 subprocess.run(['adb','-s',usb[0],'forward','--remove','tcp:18123'],capture_output=True,timeout=25)
